notes.title: Huge Prologue Update & Overhaul Ahead of Full Game Release
notes.content:
It's been a while since we've updated [b]Acolyte: Prologue[/b], but today - alongside the full beta release of the game for Transcendent Edition owners - we've also rolled out all the fixes, improvements and additions to the final game, to the Prologue. 

[b]This includes:[/b]

[list]
[*] More natural language dialogue responses 
[*] Smoother conversation flow (although still work to be done here ahead of release) 
[*] New Acolyte features (jokes/facts/games)
[*] New Customisation options 
[*] ....and a host of other fixes and improvements. 
[/list]

In addition to this, we've also released a brand new trailer for the game - showcasing the game's natural language input and ARG puzzles. 

[previewyoutube=n36pXZtA35M;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]IMPORTAT NOTE: [/b]Acolyte is still in the final phase of development where lots of bugs are purged, polish is added and generally the game comes together. You may still experience some issues. If you would like to wait for the final, polished version: please continue to wait a short while longer.  

Huge thanks. 

Jamin & the Superstring team.

notes.title: Acolyte Prologue v1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544656/9fdb10d08c28b00e57e92f8646d35ffff8af9aef.png[/img]

Back in January we released an early version of our new narrative game, Acolyte. Before development of the full  game continues, we were keen to roll out a little update to the Prologue which addresses some frequent requests and issues, and improves the overall user experience. 

In the v1.1 Update - available now! - players can benefit from:  

[list]
[*] New resolution options (and persistence between sessions)
[*] New dialogue options 
[*] Expanded vocabulary 
[*] Light Mode - dark text on light backgrounds, for those that find reading easier
[*] Improved UX and key information delivery 
[*] Various fixes and improvements 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544656/52e2bbbe6278876ef764e83ffb89593b98d9fdfd.png[/img]

To those that have yet to play the game, there's no better time. But that's not to say there's not still work to do! Please continue to reach out with your thoughts and feedback, and your comments will be channelled into the ongoing development of the full game. 

Until next time, 

Jamin
